Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision
you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please sttae your full name for the record.
A: I'd rahter just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was backing out of a space near the entrance of the shopping center. It was pretty busy, with carts and people
walking between the cars.
Q: What happened as you were backing out?
A: I checked my mirror, saw nothing coming, and started reversing slowly. Then I felt a bump on the driver's side rear.
The other car had come up the lane faster than I expected.
Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was moving?
A: Not fast, maybe walking speed or a little quicker. It wasn't a big hit, but it jolted me forward and back.
Q: Did you stop your vehicle immediately after the impact?
A: Yes, I put it in park right away and got out to look at the damage.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: I went to urgent care the same afternoon. My neck was stiff and I had pain running into my shoulders. They said it
looked like whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some medication.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. Turning my head to the right is hard, and I get headaches toward the end of the day. I've had to take time off
from my physical activities.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'd just like to get my car repiared and get back to normal.
Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
